simple.meaning: רֹבַע (rôbaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a quarter.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רֹבַע (H7255) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 23:10, with occurrences in Numbers, 2 Kings.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֹבַע (H7255) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רֹבַע (H7255) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רֹבַע (rôbaʻ) / H7255 is traced through Numbers 23:10, 2 Kings 6:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
